title: Synergy Baseball App: Video Playback and Compare
description: Control video playback, build side-by-side playlists, overlay clips and send clips to the Synergy Editor.

modules.title: Video Playback and the Player
modules.summary: Choose Playback, Editor or Compare, then use the player controls, clip duration and pre-roll.
modules.content:
## Playback modes

Pick a mode from the app menu or the top left of any view. The app remembers your choice.

![Playback mode options: Player, Editor, Compare](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565369-01.jpg)

- **Playback**: default; the built-in player.
- **Editor**: sends playlists to the **Synergy Editor** for custom edits.
- **Compare**: split-screen in the in-app player.

Click the play icon to start video.

## Player features

The redesigned player has a **Multi-Angle Layout** and a dark theme. Key controls:

![The video player with multi-angle layout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565369-02.jpg)

- **Return Arrow**: back to the Baseball app.
- **Full AB**: expands the full at-bat for the clip.

![Full AB and top-left player controls](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565369-03.jpg)
- **Playlist/Event View**: list view or chart view.

![Playlist view](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565369-04.jpg)

![Event view](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565369-05.jpg)
- **Display Pickoff Attempts**.

![Pickoff attempts shown in the playlist](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565369-06.jpg)
- **Clip Duration**: **Standard** (pitcher's release until the ball is returned or play ends) or **Extended** (all available video between pitches).
- **Pre Roll / Pitch Release Time**: how far before release the clip starts; default **3 seconds**.
- **Multi-Angle View**, **Camera Angle** menu, **Send to Editor**, **Pop-out window**, **Fullscreen**.
- **Detailed Pitch Info** under the video shows pitch type and velocity.
- Transport controls: play/pause, jump to start/end, previous/next clip, frame-by-frame, scrubber.

![Switching between Player and Compare](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565369-07.jpg)

questions.question: Which clip duration plays all available video between pitches?
questions.explanation: Extended plays all available video between pitches.

questions.question: What is the default pre-roll before pitch release?
Which mode sends playlists to the Synergy Editor?
questions.explanation: Editor mode sends playlists to the Synergy Editor.

modules.title: Side-by-Side Compare and Overlay
modules.summary: Compare two playlists with sync points and universal controls, then overlay one clip on another.
learning_objectives: Use sync points and universal controls
Start and adjust a video overlay
modules.content:
## Starting a side-by-side playlist

Filter first, then either:

**Method 1** (Multigame view): switch video option to **Compare**, choose **Send to Side-by-Side - Both**, click play.

**Method 2**: click play to open the list view, then click **Compare** at bottom right.

![Compare button at the bottom right of the clip list](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565371-01.jpg)

## In Compare mode

- **Individual play controls** under each player move only that clip.

![Play controls under each video player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565372-01.jpg)
- **Universal play controls** at the bottom move both.
- **Set** marks a sync point for each player (drag to adjust; **Set** again removes it). **Go To** jumps to the sync points.
- Collapse a playlist with its arrow; rename with **Edit**.
- **Gear icon**: **Autoplay** and **Lock Time** (keeps the same scrubber position when switching clips).
- Download buttons send clips to the Synergy Editor.

![Download buttons that send clips to the Synergy Editor](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565372-05.jpg)

## Video overlay

1. Select one clip from each side.
2. Click **Overlay** under the right playlist.

Use **Left/Right** to choose which window you are adjusting (arrow keys move it), magnifier buttons to resize, and **Change Video Opacity** to adjust transparency. While Left or Right is selected the keyboard cannot step frame by frame; deselect it or use the player's frame controls.

questions.question: What does Lock Time do in Compare mode?
options: Keeps the same scrubber time position when you switch clips
questions.explanation: Lock Time retains the time position across clip changes.

questions.question: How do you remove a sync point?
questions.explanation: Selecting Set again removes the sync point.

questions.question: What does the Change Video Opacity tool do?
options: Makes a clip more or less transparent in an overlay
questions.explanation: It adjusts the transparency of a clip during overlay.

modules.title: Sending Clips to the Synergy Editor
modules.summary: Set video to Editor, choose clip length and lead time, then send from Multigame, Single Game or Reports view.
modules.content:
## Before sending

- Set the video choice to **Editor**.
- Choose **Standard** or **Extended** clip length.
- Set the **lead duration** between **0 and 10 seconds**.

![Editor selected as the video choice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565375-01.jpg)

## How to send from each view

- **Multigame**: apply filters, then click the **Play** arrow above the chart.

![The Play arrow above the chart in Multigame view](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565375-02.jpg)
- **Single Game**: the central **Play** button sends the full game; the **Play** beside individual clip displays sends selected clips.

![Play buttons in Single Game view](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565375-03.jpg)
- **Reports**: click a box containing a number for a filter, topic or statistic. Clips go automatically to a **temporary playlist**.

![Clickable number boxes in Reports view](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565375-04.jpg)

## After sending

A temporary playlist appears in the **bottom panel of the Editor**. Use the **caret** on the playlist tab to **save, export or close** it, or drag and drop clips into an existing edit.

![Temporary playlist in the Synergy Editor](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565375-05.jpg)

You can also bring your own film into the Editor through Live Capture (covered in separate Synergy articles).

questions.question: What range can the lead duration be set to?
questions.explanation: Lead duration is configurable from 0 to 10 seconds.

questions.question: In Reports view, how do you send clips to the Editor?
options: Click a number box for the statistic
questions.explanation: Clicking a numbered box sends the clips to a temporary playlist.

questions.question: Where does the temporary playlist appear in the Editor?
questions.explanation: It shows up in the bottom panel of the Editor.
